source: Struktur- und Genehmigungsdirektion Nord / LANIS Rheinland-Pfalz (Landschaftsinformationssystem): Naturdenkmale (Punkte), point layer of individually protected natural monuments of Rhineland-Palatinate
endpoint: https://geodaten.naturschutz.rlp.de/kartendienste_naturschutz/mod_ogc/wfs_getmap.php?mapfile=naturdenkmale_punkte&SERVICE=WFS&VERSION=2.0.0&REQUEST=GetFeature&TYPENAMES=ms:naturdenkmale_punkte&SRSNAME=EPSG:4326&COUNT=1000&STARTINDEX=0 (GML 3.2; JSON output not permitted; page with STARTINDEX)
designation: Naturdenkmal (section 28 BNatSchG) by ordinance of the lower nature conservation authority; nd_key ND-<Kreisschluessel>-<number> (7211 = Trier city, 7235 = Landkreis Trier-Saarburg, 7111 = Koblenz)

licence_proof: LANIS metadata record id 4890 'Naturdenkmale (Punkte)' (geodaten.naturschutz.rlp.de/kartendienste_naturschutz/mod_metadata/ajax/gethtml.php?id=4890) states 'Nutzung entsprechend den Lizenzbestimmungen der Odbl mit Quellenangabe zulaessig' and links http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/; the sibling polygon layer is listed on open.rlp.de (flachenhafte-naturdenkmale) with Nutzungsbedingungen ODbL, 'Freie Nutzung'. The WFS GetCapabilities says Fees none, AccessConstraints none. Read 2026-10-15. ODbL permits commercial reuse with attribution; share-alike binds only a redistributed derived database, not pages or maps produced from it.
attribution: Die Daten wurden unter Verwendung der amtlichen Geofachdaten des Landschaftsinformationssystems Rheinland-Pfalz (LANIS) erzeugt. Sie unterliegen der Open Database Lizenz (ODbL). Extract of 2026-10-15.
scope: Whole state: 1676 points, of which 1486 have a tree word in the name. Trier city (ND-7211): 199 points, 196 tree-named. Landkreis Trier-Saarburg (ND-7235): 46 points.
caveat: Fields are key, free-text name (often with count, Latin species and street or site, e.g. 'ND Nr. 70, 1 Blauzeder Cedrus atlantica, Kornmarkt') and links to a report and the decree PDF. No girth, height, age or vitality in the layer; the decree PDF may hold them. Pins are digitised points, so approximate unless a crown is visible. Group rows (4 Linden, 25 Platanen, Alleen) are not single collectible points. Many Trier rows are on cemetery (Hauptfriedhof), abbey (St. Matthias), Karthaeuser Hof arboretum (about 30 exotic conifers, Eitelsbach), Quint estate park and Mutterhaus grounds: access per hard rule 10 unchecked, so publishable is false everywhere. Some rows share a key number twice (ND Nr. 203 appears at two places). Not checked whether any tree has since fallen.
